rows.grounds: Gloss 'and-he-requested'; form vyajijñapacca = vyajijñapat + ca; root √jñā (caus. jñapay), aorist 3sg. active.
Gloss 'that'; form taṃ = acc.sg.m. of tad.
Gloss 'pleased'; form tuṣṭaṃ = past passive participle of √tuṣ, acc.sg.m.
Gloss 'lord'; form nāthaṃ = acc.sg.m. of nātha.
Gloss 'in-rains-I'; form varṣāsvahaṃ = varṣāsu (loc.pl.f. of varṣā) + ahaṃ (1sg.nom.); sandhi varṣāsu + ahaṃ > varṣāsvahaṃ.
Gloss 'in-my-own'; form nije = loc.sg.m. of nija.
Gloss 'in-netherworld'; form pātāle = loc.sg.m. of pātāla.
Gloss 'not-to-stay'; form nāsituṃ = na + asitum (infinitive of √as 'to be/stay'); negative prefix na sandhi to nā-.
Gloss 'able'; form śaktaḥ = past participle of √śak, nom.sg.m. (predicative).
Gloss 'and-he-also-this-one'; form so 'py enaṃ = saḥ + api + enam with sandhi (so 'pi); saḥ nom.sg.m., api indecl., enam acc.sg.m. of ena.
Gloss 'supreme-lord'; form parameśvaraḥ = compound parama + īśvara (member+membership: karmanadhāraya/tatpuruṣa type per context), nom.sg.m.
